profile.visual_desc: Massive muscular figure in navy-blue plate armor and a heavy, billowing dark cape. Wears a dark mask with a single horizontal red glowing visor and prominent white swept-back horns.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Profile view facing right. Features a dark armored mask, a sharp chin, and a singular glowing red eye-line beneath white curved horns.
profile.weapon_desc: Channeled energy erupting from the ground via a physical strike.
profile.step1_ready: Stands tall in a front-isometric view, fists clenched at sides with a wide, tattered navy cape flared behind.
profile.step2_windup: Flexes with blue electric sparks, then drops into a low crouch, punching the ground to summon a vertical blue light beam.
profile.step3_impact: A massive, thick golden energy pillar erupts vertically from a glowing circular seal on the ground.
profile.step4_finish: Holds the crouched pose as the golden pillar fades into a bright light, transitioning back to a resting stance.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The energy effect is a vertical golden cylinder erupting upward, triggered by the character's downward ground-punch.

evaluation.diagnosis: Sequence maintains perspective and windup. Strike VFX positioning shows minor deviations from reference.
